integrity: All proof steps use explicit polynomial identities and positivity; finite rational checks are ancillary. The earliest public motivating-source date is verified from the Royal Society online publication record. Historical priority remains provisional; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two habitat patches, a common symmetric mixing matrix, four prescribed positive diagonal seasonal growth profiles, a deterministic periodic linear invasion/growth objective. The theorem does not establish nonlinear equilibria or stochastic extinction probabilities.
title: Four-season ecological growth has an exact temporal-order reversal at half dispersal
